records.title: Mixture of experts architectures for machine learning interatomic potentials
records.reason: The MoE architecture is for machine-learning interatomic potentials, not language-model inference or serving.

records.title: UETrack: A Unified and Efficient Framework for Single Object Tracking
records.reason: The abstract concerns efficient single-object visual tracking; no LLM inference or serving contribution is described.

records.title: Learning to Steer, Steering to See: Unveiling the Geometry of RLVR in Large Language Models via Trainable Vectors
records.reason: The paper studies RLVR training dynamics and uses trainable activation-space vectors to analyze/recover low-dimensional steering directions. Its procedures compare RL-training updates, frozen-base activations, and gradient interventions; it does not propose or evaluate LLM serving, inference compute reduction, latency, throughput, or memory savings. The lineage link does not match this training-analysis contribution.

records.title: MA-WAM: Multi-Agent World-Action Model for Test-Time Planning
records.reason: MA-WAM uses a world-action model to generate/rank candidate multi-agent trajectories at test time. Reported planning can improve task returns over reactive policies, but uses up to eight candidate rollouts; its cost discussion concerns world-model test-time planning, not LLM inference/serving or reducing compute. It evaluates coordination benchmarks rather than LLM workloads; benefits are limited near the task ceiling and experiments use M=8/horizon cap 8.

records.title: All-in-One Multilingual Scene Text Recognition with Script-aware Mixture-of-Experts
records.reason: The paper applies script-aware MoE to multilingual scene-text recognition, not LLM inference or serving.
